question: As per flag code of India 2002, What should be the position of the Indian flag when it is displayed along with flags of other countries in a straight line? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Anywhere in the row
Extreme left
Extreme right
In the middle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Extreme right

Explanation:
India's national flag holds the highest position among all national symbols. According to the Flag Code of India 2002, when the Indian flag is displayed along with flags of other countries in a straight line, it must be placed at the extreme right end of the row. This position is considered the most honorable because, in parades and formal displays, the right side is leading. The flag should also be kept at the same height or higher than other flags. This rule reflects India's sovereignty and dignity. The code was enacted on 26 January 2002 and is legally binding under the Emblems and Names (Prevention of Improper Use) Act, 1950.

☛ When did the Flag Code of India 2002 come into effect? → 26 January 2002

question: Which of the following state has the highest wind energy production in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Odisha
Karnataka
Maharashtra
Tamil Nadu
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tamil Nadu

Explanation:

It is followed by Gujarat and Maharashtra. Major wind farms in Tamil Nadu include Muppandal and Kayathar. The state's geographical location and high wind speeds in coastal areas make it ideal for wind energy generation. According to the National Institute of Wind Energy (NIWE), Tamil Nadu leads in wind power production.

question: Where was the first oil well discovered in Assam? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Digboi
Rudrasagar
Naharkatiya
Moran Hugrijan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Digboi

Explanation:
The first oil well in Assam was discovered at Digboi. It is the oldest oil field in India and was discovered in 1889. The Digboi oil field is located in the Tinsukia district of Assam. The Digboi Refinery, established in 1901, is also located here. Digboi is often called the 'Oil City of India'. This discovery laid the foundation of the petroleum industry in India. Other options like Rudrasagar, Naharkatiya, and Moran Hugrijan are also oil fields in Assam but were discovered later than Digboi.

question: FTTP stands for: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Frame To The Permission
Fiber To The Premises
Fusion To The Premises
Fiber To The Permission
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Fiber To The Premises

Explanation:
FTTP stands for Fiber To The Premises. It is a broadband network architecture where optical fiber is run directly to the user's premises, such as a home or business. This technology provides high-speed internet access and offers greater bandwidth and reliability compared to traditional copper cables. FTTP is often referred to as FTTH (Fiber To The Home) or FTTB (Fiber To The Building). It is a key application of fiber optic communication.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of FTTP? → Fiber To The Premises
☛ On which technology is FTTP based? → Fiber optics
☛ What is FTTP used for? → High-speed internet
☛ What is a type of FTTP? → FTTH (Fiber To The Home)
☛ Where does the fiber go in FTTP? → To the user's premises

question: Who among the following stepped down as the Director-General of the World Trade Organization on 31st Aug 2020? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Roberto Azevedo
Pascal Lamy
Charles Gomez
David Walker
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Roberto Azevedo

Explanation:
Roberto Azevedo stepped down as the Director-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO) on August 31, 2020. He was a Brazilian diplomat who assumed office on September 1, 2013, succeeding Pascal Lamy. His term was scheduled to end on August 31, 2021, but he resigned early amid the COVID-19 pandemic and global trade tensions. After his resignation, Yonov Frederick Agah served as the interim Director-General. The WTO headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland, and it was established on January 1, 1995. During Azevedo's tenure, negotiations on e-commerce and fisheries subsidies were key priorities. He was praised for his efforts to modernize the organization.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ When was WTO established? → January 1, 1995
☛ Who was WTO DG before Azevedo? → Pascal Lamy

☛ How many member countries in WTO? → 164

question: What is Optical Distribution Network (ODN)? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: The physical fibres that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.
The physical fibres that distribute signals to users in an electronic circuit.
The physical fibre and optical devices that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.
The optical devices that cannot distribute signals.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The physical fibre and optical devices that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.

Explanation:
An Optical Distribution Network (ODN) is a key component of a fiber optic telecommunication network, specifically in Passive Optical Networks (PON). It consists of physical fibers and optical devices such as splitters and couplers that distribute optical signals from the OLT (Optical Line Terminal) to multiple ONTs (Optical Network Terminals) at user premises. The ODN is passive, meaning it does not contain active electronic components, which makes it cost-effective and reliable. It enables high-speed broadband access to many users without active power in the distribution path.

☛ Which terminals does ODN connect? → OLT to ONT
☛ Does ODN have active electronics? → No, it is passive
question_hi: ऑप्टिकल डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन नेटवर्क (ODN) क्या है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)

भौतिक फाइबर जो इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सर्किट में उपयोगकर्ताओं को सिग्नल वितरित करते हैं।
भौतिक फाइबर और ऑप्टिकल उपकरण हैं जो दूरसंचार नेटवर्क में उपयोगकर्ताओं को सिग्नल वितरित करते हैं।
वे ऑप्टिकल उपकरण जो सिग्नल वितरित नहीं कर सकते।
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है भौतिक फाइबर और ऑप्टिकल उपकरण हैं जो दूरसंचार नेटवर्क में उपयोगकर्ताओं को सिग्नल वितरित करते हैं।

Explanation:
ODN या ऑप्टिकल डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन नेटवर्क एक फाइबर ऑप्टिक नेटवर्क का हिस्सा है जो टेलीकॉम नेटवर्क में OLT (ऑप्टिकल लाइन टर्मिनल) से ONT (ऑप्टिकल नेटवर्क टर्मिनल) तक सिग्नल पहुंचाता है। यह केवल फाइबर केबल ही नहीं, बल्कि स्प्लिटर, कप्लर और अन्य ऑप्टिकल डिवाइस भी शामिल करता है। PON (पैसिव ऑप्टिकल नेटवर्क) में यह एक प्रमुख घटक है। ODN बिना सक्रिय इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स के सिग्नल वितरण करता है, जिससे यह लागत प्रभावी और विश्वसनीय बनता है।

question: 'Bhotiya' is a caste of scheduled tribes of which of the following states in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Uttarakhand
Rajasthan
Maharashtra
Madhya Pradesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Uttarakhand

Explanation:
The Bhotiya tribe primarily inhabits the higher Himalayan regions of Uttarakhand. They belong to the Tibeto-Burmese language family and are recognized as a Scheduled Tribe. They are mainly found in the valleys of Johar, Niti, Mana, and Niti. Their primary occupations are animal husbandry and trade. The Bhotiya community has several sub-tribes like Tolcha, Marcha, and Jad. Historically, they have been active in India-Tibet trade for centuries. Currently, they reside in border areas, and their culture is influenced by Buddhism.

☛ Which language family does the Bhotiya tribe belong to? → Tibeto-Burmese
☛ Which religion influences the Bhotiya tribe? → Buddhism
question_hi: 'भोटिया' भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य की अनुसूचित जनजाति की एक जाति है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 1)

महाराष्ट्र
मध्य प्रदेश

Explanation:
भोटिया जनजाति मुख्यतः उत्तराखंड के उच्च हिमालयी क्षेत्रों में निवास करती है। यह तिब्बती-बर्मी भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है और इन्हें अनुसूचित जनजाति का दर्जा प्राप्त है। ये मुख्यतः जौहर, नीति, माणा और नीति घाटियों में पाए जाते हैं। इनका मुख्य व्यवसाय पशुपालन और व्यापार है। भोटिया जनजाति की कई उपजातियाँ हैं जैसे तोलछा, मार्छा और जाद। यह जनजाति सदियों से भारत-तिब्बत व्यापार में सक्रिय रही है। वर्तमान में ये सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रों में निवास करते हैं और इनकी संस्कृति बौद्ध धर्म से प्रभावित है।

question: The Government of India Constituted Narcotics Control Bureau in ________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1984
1980
1986
1982
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1986

Explanation:
The Government of India constituted the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) on March 17, 1986. It functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Its headquarters is located in New Delhi. The primary objective of NCB is to prevent the illicit trafficking of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances. It operates under the NDPS Act, 1985. The first Director-General of NCB was R. N. Srivastava. This agency also collaborates internationally. Currently, NCB conducts campaigns against drug trafficking across the country.

question: Pushkar Mela is held in Pushkar. Which district does it come under? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Amer
Ajmer

question: Which of the following is NOT a world heritage site? (RRB JE ME (19/09/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Kaziranga National Park
Periyar National Park
Manas Wildlife Sanctuary
Nanda Devi National Park
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Periyar National Park

Explanation:
Periyar National Park, located in Kerala, is a significant wildlife sanctuary but is not recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In contrast, Kaziranga National Park (Assam), Manas Wildlife Sanctuary (Assam), and Nanda Devi National Park (Uttarakhand) are all UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Kaziranga, famous for its one-horned rhinoceros, was designated a World Heritage Site in 1985. Manas Wildlife Sanctuary received World Heritage status in 1985, while Nanda Devi National Park was inscribed in 1988. Periyar National Park is known for its elephant and tiger populations, but it is not on the World Heritage list.

मानस वन्यजीव अभयारण्य
नंदा देवी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान
solution_hi:

Explanation:
पेरियार राष्ट्रीय उद्यान केरल में स्थित एक महत्वपूर्ण वन्यजीव अभयारण्य है, लेकिन इसे यूनेस्को द्वारा विश्व धरोहर स्थल के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त नहीं है। दूसरी ओर, काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (असम), मानस वन्यजीव अभयारण्य (असम) और नंदा देवी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (उत्तराखंड) सभी यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल हैं। काजीरंगा अपने एक सींग वाले गैंडों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है और इसे 1985 में विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया था। मानस वन्यजीव अभयारण्य को 1985 में विश्व धरोहर स्थल का दर्जा मिला, जबकि नंदा देवी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान को 1988 में शामिल किया गया। पेरियार राष्ट्रीय उद्यान मुख्य रूप से हाथियों और बाघों के लिए जाना जाता है, लेकिन यह विश्व धरोहर सूची में नहीं है।

question: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was proclaimed by the UN in the year: (RRB JE EE (01/09/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: 1947
1949
1948
1946
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1948

Explanation:
The United Nations General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) on 10 December 1948 in Paris. It is a historic document that outlines 30 articles of fundamental human rights to be universally protected by all nations. The declaration was drafted under the leadership of American diplomat Eleanor Roosevelt and was approved by 48 countries in favor, while 8 countries abstained. The UDHR is considered the cornerstone of international human rights law and later inspired binding treaties like the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights and the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights.
